module.Title: Create Alarm Levels
module.Teaching: elif adds ordered conditions between if and else. Python stops at the first branch that matches.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why must the critical condition come first?
PredictionOptions: A critical value also meets the warning condition
module.PredictionExplanation: Checking the highest threshold first prevents it from being classified only as a warning.
module.DebugPrompt: The warning branch catches critical temperatures before the later condition can run.
module.RecallPrompt: Create Critical, Warning, and Normal temperature branches. Use the exact identifier print. Use these exact values: 30, 40.
module.TransferPrompt: Classify pressure as High at 80+, Elevated at 60+, otherwise Normal. Use the exact identifier print.
module.PreviewMessage: The alarm panel now displays three severity levels.
